name: fdm_wanhao_d9_mk1_common
machine_start_gcode:
; Wanhao Duplicator 9 start G-code, for the Marlin 2.1 firmwares at github.com/Le-Syl21/WANHAO-Duplicator-9
G21 ; millimetres
G90 ; absolute coordinates
M83 ; relative extrusion
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; heat the bed
M104 S150 ; warm the nozzle without letting it ooze
G91 ; a print stopped by hand can leave the nozzle down on the bed
G1 Z10 F300 ; clear the bed before homing
G90
G28 ; home all axes (this turns bed levelling off)
M420 S1 ; turn the bed mesh saved from the screen back on
G1 Z10 F300
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; start the nozzle now, the bed is still heating
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for the bed
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; and confirm the nozzle
G92 E0
G1 X15 Y20 Z0.3 F3000 ; start of the priming line
G1 Y140 E9.0 F1200 ; draw a line of filament
G1 X15.5 F3000
G1 Y20 E9.0 F1200 ; and back, next to it
G92 E0
G1 X22 F6000 ; wipe sideways to snap the string
G1 Z2 F300 ; lift, so the line does not stick to the nozzle
